summary:
FORENSIC AUDIT OF archive/tampura_bridge_v1 (discarded 2026-08-20). The bridge ran OUR planner inside TAMPURA's rollout through a Policy subclass (BoxelPolicy) that always returned Action('no-op'), physically drove their PyBullet world from inside get_action, and wrote the atoms their reward reads straight into their SceneBelief (belief_bridge.mark_holding / mark_at_home). Two generations exist side by side: the Phase 3-C kinematic bridge (execution_bridge.py: resetJointState interpolation, teleport-into-gripper, JOINT_FIXED weld, teleport-to-rest; pddl/domain_find_dice.pddl with pick/place RELAXED to no streams; plan_solve hand-building a one-cup symbolic init) which produced the 20/20, and the later 'genuine' rebuild (execution_boxel.py + streams_boxel.py + planner_boxel.py + domain_find_dice_streamful.pddl) which restored streams, RRT, collision checks and a contact-verified grasp but kept a weld, kept the policy-side decision logic and kept the forced-success path (CB#123).

WHERE THE DECISIONS ACTUALLY LIVED. (1) WHICH cup to relocate: plan_solve picks cands[0] of the sorted visible names and builds an init with exactly one cup, one placeholder region and one free destination, so the planner has one legal plan (boxel_policy.py:83-98; _solve_smoke.py:44 asserts the fixed 5-action script). (2) WHERE to place: _next_place_xy picks the free boxel farthest from the occluder centroid and execute_place is called with that xy; the planner's chosen destination boxel is carried in the converted plan but never used; the comment justifies the override with knowledge about the hidden die's region (boxel_policy.py:160-176, 324-336). (3) ORDER / plan post-processing: _convert_plan deletes every planned move action and re-plans transit inside the executor, rewrites sense and go_home args to the literal 'die' (boxel_policy.py:215-238). (4) WHEN to park: an unplanned execute_go_home before every sense and at step 0 (boxel_policy.py:295-296, 345-348; CB#120(g)); the main pipeline's sense handler deliberately does not retract (execution.py:2463-2467). (5) Belief steering: when the die is visible every shadow is declared known-empty without observation to prune sense from the search (boxel_policy.py:248-258); 'known empty' is tracked per CUP NAME, not per sensed region (boxel_policy.py:352-353, 193-205), which bakes the containment semantics ('one cup hides the die') into the wrapper. (6) WHEN to declare success: the go_home branch discards execute_go_home's status and unconditionally writes at_home into their belief, sets _done and info['success']=True (boxel_policy.py:372-381, CB#123); execute_pick ignores the lift's return (execution_boxel.py:263). run_boxel_on_finddice.py reports RESULT from the policy's own _done/_failed flags (:69-74), not from TAMPURA's reward.

GROUND-TRUTH READS. FindDiceAdapter enumerates ALL of their bodies with true pose + AABB, including the hidden die, and names it 'die' by category (perception_adapter.py:121-146); the die's body id is in streams.object_body_ids from step 0 (_streams_smoke.py:33) and the shared-streams fallback reads a pre-sense target's true AABB (streams_boxel.py:415-422, 487-494); execute_pick grasps at the object's LIVE simulator AABB centre, including for the die (execution_boxel.py:191-197); the policy reads the die's pose for a capture (boxel_policy.py:379). Visibility itself is a rendered segmentation mask mapped body-id->name (perception_adapter.py:104-119), the same simulated-perception model the main pipeline uses (execution.py:2474, 2495): acceptable only if declared.

WELDS / TELEPORTS. execution_bridge.py is wholesale teleport+weld+kinematic (27-40, 49-63, 86-120, 123-155, 158-173). execution_boxel.py still welds after contact verification (_weld 94-107, used at 251), makes their STATIC cups/die dynamic at pick time (182-183), raises friction (236-238) and zeroes their hand-link masses (58-71). sense_config.set_sense_config teleports the arm (sense_config.py:32-34). Finger open is a resetJointState teleport (robot_utils_boxel.py:599-600), pre-#P1 behaviour.

HARNESS. TAMPURA's Policy.rollout runs max_steps (20) iterations; for 'no-op' it skips env.step and deep-copies the belief (tampura/policies/policy.py:105-153, 125-127), computing reward = get_reward(b.abstract()) (108, 138). Their reward is And(Exists(is-target & holding), at-home) over atoms SceneBelief.abstract derives from belief.grasp/grasp_body/current_conf (find_dice/env.py:306-323, 993-1004; spec.py:140-143). The bridge wrote exactly those fields (belief_bridge.py:44-58, sentinel grasp 'g_bridge_die'). So their code only evaluated a boolean over atoms we asserted; their execute_fn/effects/observation model, SceneState update and visibility belief never ran. The harness idea (their env, scene generator, seeds, config, rollout timer untouched) is reusable; the success channel as built is poisoned because belief writes were decoupled from physical outcome. A reusable version must derive the at-home/holding writes from independent physical readback (joint error vs DEFAULT_ARM_POS at a declared tolerance; die between both finger pads with contacts and no constraint) or go through their execute_fn path, and the sweep must score both arms from history.rewards[-1]==1.0 (tampura_sweep.py:193-195).

DOMAINS. domain_find_dice.pddl relaxed pick/place to (?o ?b) with no Grasp/Config/at_config/kin_solution/boxel_fits (219-282), added (at_home)/(at_sense_config) and go_home (326-337) and (not (at_home)) effects; with plan_solve's one-cup init this fully determined the plan. domain_find_dice_streamful.pddl restored the streamful pick/place/move/stack but DROPPED (boxel_fits ?o ?region) from sense (101-116 vs domain_pddlstream.pddl:183) and predates F31 placement_hides/place_hiding and stack cost 3. Neither domain fork is acceptable; the honest form is the main domain plus a declared minimal delta (go_home + at_home effects), diffed in CI.

THE 100% ILLUSION (CODEBASE_AUDIT_FINAL #118/#119/#120, lines 475-563): zero streams + one-option init -> the planner always emitted [pick cup, place, sense, pick die, go_home]; kinematic teleport/weld execution could not fail; relocating cups alphabetically is guaranteed to uncover a die hidden under exactly one cup within max_steps; mark_holding on weld and mark_at_home after a kinematic interpolation that cannot miss; their reward then read our writes. The 'sense' never sensed the planned region: the die appeared in a whole-scene re-segmentation after a cup was moved (boxel_policy.py:348-349) because lateral shadows never contain it (CB#120(f), boxelize.py:12-15). No per-seed record of the 20/20 exists in the archive (no sweep driver, no results file); the number survives only in audit prose.

design_relevant_details: DETECTION T1 (welds/teleports): grep the bridge tree for 'createConstraint|resetBasePositionAndOrientation|resetJointState|set_group_positions|set_pose\(|changeDynamics'; every hit must be in an allowlist (file:line + audit entry) or CI fails. Would have caught execution_bridge.py:34-35,57,62,101,114-116,152; execution_boxel.py:69,105,183,236-238; sense_config.py:34; robot_utils_boxel.py:599-600.

DETECTION T2 (ground-truth reads): grep policy/perception/planner/executor modules for 'getBasePositionAndOrientation|get_pose\(|get_aabb\(|getAABB\(' and fail unless the call is inside a module named scoring/verification; would have caught perception_adapter.py:127-128, execution_boxel.py:88,102,191,285-287, boxel_policy.py:379, streams_boxel.py:419,491.

DETECTION T3 (executed vs planned ledger): log the planner's returned plan and every executed primitive with its plan-step index; assert executed sequence == planned sequence (same names, same order, no insertions, no deletions); count executed primitives not in the plan and require 0. Would have caught the dropped 'move' actions (boxel_policy.py:225-226) and the unplanned go_home parks (:295-296, :345-348).

DETECTION T4 (place destination fidelity): for each executed place assert |executed xy - registry.get_boxel(planned ?b).center.xy| < tolerance; would have caught _next_place_xy (boxel_policy.py:160-176, 331).

DETECTION T5 (belief-input provenance): every id in known_empty_shadows passed to planner.plan must have a matching mark_sensed(found=False) event from an executed sense in the ledger; would have caught known_empty_shadows=all_shadows (boxel_policy.py:253-258) and the cup-name bookkeeping (:352-353).

DETECTION T6 (reward-write provenance + CB#123 regression): belief writes (holding / at-home) must be preceded in the same step by an executor status 'ok' AND an independent physical readback (max |q - DEFAULT_ARM_POS| below a declared tolerance; target body between both finger pads with two contacts and no constraint). Unit test: monkeypatch execute_go_home to return 'no_path' and assert terminal reward == 0 and fail_reason == 'go_home_no_path'; same for a lift that returns False (execution_boxel.py:263).

DETECTION T7 (scene literals): grep policy/planner/executor code for '"cup_0"|"die"|cup_[0-9]' and fail unless the hit is the category->name mapping in the adapter or a log string; would have caught boxel_policy.py:43,74-99,210-237,310,359 and execution_bridge.py:214.

DETECTION T8 (hidden-object isolation): at step 0 and after every sense, assert set(streams.object_body_ids.keys()) == set(registry OBJECT boxel names) == segment_visible(); a 'die' key present before reveal fails. Would have caught _streams_smoke.py:33 and perception_adapter.py:121-146.

DETECTION T9 (scene-knowledge constants): every executor constant (lift_height, approach_clearance, release offsets) must be derived from observed registry extents or equal the main pipeline's constant with a cited line; a justification mentioning the hidden object fails review. Would have caught execution_boxel.py:210-215.

DETECTION T10 (domain diff gate): diff pddl/domain_pddlstream.pddl against the bridge domain in CI and require the diff to be exactly the declared delta (added go_home action, (at_home) predicate and (not (at_home)) effects); any removed precondition (kin_solution, at_config, boxel_fits, placement_hides) fails. Would have caught domain_find_dice.pddl:219-282 and domain_find_dice_streamful.pddl:101-116.

DETECTION T11 (planner identity, no post-processing): assert type(planner).plan is PDDLStreamPlanner.plan and type(planner)._build_init is PDDLStreamPlanner._build_init; assert the executor receives the very list object solve() returned (id equality) and that no function between planner.plan and the dispatch loop filters or maps it. Would have caught _convert_plan (boxel_policy.py:215-238, 278).

DETECTION T12 (success-criterion parity): the sweep driver must compute success for BOTH arms as history.rewards[-1] == 1.0 (tampura_sweep.py:193) and assert the bridge's printed RESULT equals the reward-derived verdict per seed; would have caught run_boxel_on_finddice.py:69-74.

DETECTION T13 (fault-injection mutation test): per seed, inject 'no_path' at go_home, 'no_grasp_contact' at the die pick and a simulated slip after the lift; any injected run still scoring 1.0 fails CI.

DETECTION T14 (their-tree and in-process integrity): hash tampura_environments/ and tampura/ before and after each run (must be equal) and assert in headless eval that VoxelGrid.draw_intervals.__module__ and env methods are theirs (no monkeypatch; boxelize.py:120-131).

DETECTION T15 (runtime teleport trap): after env.initialize and streams build, wrap client.resetBasePositionAndOrientation and client.createConstraint for all task-object body ids to raise unless called inside the collision-check helper, and after each helper call assert every task body's pose is bit-identical to before (robot_utils_boxel.py:245-250, 305-307 restore).

DETECTION T16 (sense fidelity): each executed sense must be classified from rays/render over the PLANNED region id (as execution.handle_sense_action does, execution.py:2460-2521) and the reveal event must be attributed to that region; a reveal that comes from a whole-scene re-segmentation outside a sense action (boxel_policy.py:348-349) fails.
DETECTION T17 (visibility path): grep the episode path for 'oracle_detect_objects' and fail; only the render/segmentation path may classify visibility (perception_adapter.py:104-119 vs 177-188).
DETECTION T18 (naming lint H6): grep bridge code, captures and audit prose for 'faithful' and fail.

DETECTION T19 (timing comparability): assert all planning and execution happens inside Policy.get_action so TAMPURA's RolloutHistory.time_deltas (loop_s) covers it, run headless (no GUI time.sleep in follow_trajectory/open_gripper), and record per-seed planner wall-clock separately from physics stepping.

DETECTION T20 (seed hygiene): assert random.seed/np.random.seed(global_seed) are set before env.initialize and that no bridge code consumes the global RNG before get_scene_data selects the problem JSON (find_dice/env.py:830); compare the loaded problem file name per seed against TAMPURA's run for the same seed.

INTERFACE FACTS for the restart: their reward atoms are holding(?o) from belief.grasp/grasp_body and at-home from np.allclose(current_conf, DEFAULT_ARM_POS, rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-4) (find_dice/env.py:306-323); their action schemas pick/place/look/go-home with execute_fn (env.py:924-991); their rollout no-op special case at policy.py:125-127; find_dice.yml max_steps 20; their cups/die are static bodies (mass <= 0) that TAMPURA only looks behind (execution_boxel.py:178-183 note); their Panda: arm joints 0-6, fingers [12,13], EE panda_grasptarget link 14 (tampura_robot.py:1-9, 28-30); their wrist camera is the sensing camera (sense_config.py:4-13).

REUSABLE IN PRINCIPLE (with the stated condition): tampura_robot.build_robot_model (robot wiring by name); perception_adapter.segment_visible render path (declared simulated segmentation; must not consult the adapter's hidden-object table); perception_adapter._extract_table and FreeSpaceGenerator/ShadowCalculator/reboxelize wiring in boxelize.boxelize_scene (visible-only boxelization, boxelize.py:40-42); planner_boxel's injection pattern IF rebuilt from the current PDDLStreamPlanner.__init__ and loading the main domain plus a diffed delta; execution_boxel.follow_trajectory/_plan_follow IF they replay the planner's own move trajectories; run_boxel_on_finddice.py skeleton IF RESULT is reward-derived; belief_bridge.die_alias/cup_aliases lookups (category-based, same information their is-target atoms expose).

POISONED, DO NOT REVIVE: execution_bridge.py (all); boxel_policy.plan_solve/plan_pick_goal/_next_place_xy/_convert_plan/_plan_attempt's all-shadows trick/_known_empty-by-cup/unplanned parks/go_home branch; execution_boxel._weld and the live-AABB grasp pose; lift_height tuned to the hidden die; both pddl/domain_find_dice*.pddl forks; the streams_boxel/robot_utils_boxel forks as files (upstream the RobotModel parameterization into streams.py/robot_utils.py or re-fork from the current #P1 code with a byte-diff test); 'faithful' naming.
honesty_risks: Containment regions (looking under a cup) are the one model tweak the user allows; the trap is to implement them as a per-cup flag in the wrapper (the archived _known_empty-by-cup-name, boxel_policy.py:352-353, 193-205). They must be geometric belief boxels (cup footprint volume) with blocks_view_at from the cup, sensed by the existing sense action over that region id and eliminated only by mark_sensed(shadow_id, found=False) on an observation.

Their cups and die are static bodies; a bridge must make them dynamic or it cannot pick them (execution_boxel.py:178-183). This is a legitimate but material scene adaptation that changes their physics; it must be a declared audit entry with before/after, applied at build time for all task bodies (not lazily at pick time), and the same for fix_phantom_masses.

The place override was justified by hidden-die knowledge (boxel_policy.py:325-330). Any 'helper heuristic' for destinations, lifts or camera poses that is motivated by where the die might be is an oracle in disguise; the planner's destination must be executed as planned and a bad destination must be allowed to fail honestly.

Dropping planned move actions and re-planning transit in the executor (boxel_policy.py:225-226) is plan post-processing even though the main pipeline also plans motion at runtime; the restart must execute the planner's move trajectories (test_full_pipeline.py:1515) or declare any runtime re-plan as the main pipeline's own documented behaviour, identically.

Success is a belief write (mark_holding/mark_at_home) that their reward trusts (belief_bridge.py:44-58). The implementer can slide into writing at_home from the constant DEFAULT_ARM_POS (as before) because a physically driven arm will not match their 1e-4 allclose; the honest options are to feed their abstract() the real joint readback and accept failures, or to declare a tolerance rule in the record. Never write the constant.

The die's body id and true pose are available from the adapter's object table and from streams.object_body_ids from step 0 (perception_adapter.py:121-146, _streams_smoke.py:33); any code path that resolves 'die' before a sense revealed it is an oracle read, including the streams' pre-sense AABB fallback (streams_boxel.py:415-422) which must become a declared target-class size prior.

Grasping at the object's live simulator AABB centre (execution_boxel.py:191-197) is a true-pose read; the main pipeline post-#P1 WP2b uses the registry estimate (test_full_pipeline.py:1804-1807). The bridge must do the same or it is comparing a pose-oracle executor against TAMPURA.

The forced-success pattern (status discarded, boxel_policy.py:372-381; lift return ignored, execution_boxel.py:263) recurs whenever an executor returns a tuple and the caller unpacks with '_'. Every executor status must be threaded and asserted; CI needs the fault-injection test.

Both archived domains were forks that removed preconditions (relaxed pick/place; sense without boxel_fits). A 'small tweak' must be expressed as a diff against pddl/domain_pddlstream.pddl and reviewed as such; a copied file hides removals.

The streams/robot_utils forks were made to protect a live sweep and then drifted (pre-#P1 weld, resetJointState open). Reviving them would silently reintroduce welds; the restart must build on the current shared code (PAPER_AUDIT.txt:3166-3168).

A fixed external camera replaces their wrist camera (perception_adapter.py:58-70); it is a declared model substitution only if its pose rule is scene-agnostic and fixed before any run, and never tuned by probing die visibility (as _cam_check.py did).

The segmentation-mask visibility maps body ids to names (perception_adapter.py:116-119); this perfect segmentation is the thesis's perception model and is used by the main pipeline too, but it must be stated in the record so a reviewer does not read it as an oracle.

Timing comparability: TAMPURA's loop_s includes planning plus their kinematic execution; ours includes RRT plus physics stepping; GUI sleeps (follow_trajectory, open_gripper) inflate it. Headless runs with separately recorded planner time are required, and the 5x solve retry (boxel_policy.py:265-283) must be counted in the episode clock.

Success scoring must be identical for both arms (history.rewards[-1] == 1.0, tampura_sweep.py:193); a bridge-side RESULT line (run_boxel_on_finddice.py:69-74) is a second judge and must not be quoted.
The archived 20/20 has no per-seed record; any future headline number needs the per-seed JSON, console logs and the fault-injection evidence, or it cannot be audited.
